method: Complete independent informal proof and separately implemented exact Cartesian operator checks

items.result: Symbol bounds at every order and uniform trace give precompactness in each C^j with a unique uniform limit. No analytic regularity is inferred.

Division by m^2-(s+1)^2 preserves rapid Fourier decay off the one possible resonance. Downward log-polynomial recurrence and kernel integration give smooth coefficients. The infinity of source modes is permitted.

Cut off both density and particular stream; h=f_x+Delta psi0 is compact and odd-odd. Add its full-plane Green inverse. Tail beta_m estimates are geometric on r>=2R, all angular/radial derivatives included. The total stream is globally smooth with sublinear velocity and the correct gauge.
The138lemma applies to the smooth global difference after subtracting the finite cutoffs, with b<1 noncritical. Retained moments are moments of that difference, not divergent original-source moments.

The radial identity has positive TB and T maps S^b for b<p. Product errors gain delta in the threshold; logarithmic lower terms remain S^p. Each step lowers the threshold by at least delta/2; finitely many steps suffice for each finite target.
Induced deficits delta+t1+t2 and harmonic deficits m+2+t2 stay in kdelta+2l. Collect equal degrees/log powers. Highest power/log comparison proves uniqueness of rho and totalU only.

A resonance requires (k+1)delta to be an even integer. This is impossible for irrational delta. Logfree input then stays logfree at every finite depth. Rational divisibility is necessary only; absent source projections can prevent logs.
No series convergence, radius uniform over profiles, analytic trace, or primary endpoint is asserted. The highest-mode cascade requires separate finite-leading support.

gate_repair: Initial test incorrectly expected every resonant stream log degree to exceed the original density log degree. At s=-13,n=13,d=1 the resonant source loses its leading degree under d_x. Repaired the test to compare to the actual source degree, as the proof states. The proof itself required no change.
